about.whoWeAreDesc:
Welcome to the Association of Business Women in Commerce & Industry (ABWCI),

A global chamber for women entrepreneurs - enabling and celebrating women's business acumen & ambition through connecting our members to industry leaders, professional development resources, and relevant opportunities.

We are a community that ranges from prominent women entrepreneurs to educational institutions, and companies investing in women. We aim to empower and support women in business by providing a global networking platform. At ABWCI, we understand, and value the vital role women entrepreneurs play in driving economic growth and employment generation. We strive to create a world for women entrepreneurs where they have fewer challenges to funding access, regulatory barriers, entrepreneurial education and more.

At ABWCI we are re-defining networking and invite you to join this community of committed, passionate, successful and influential women in business!

We are here to help your business grow and prosper.
about.ourVisionDesc: We aim to become the most influential global, collaborative chamber for business women, driving inclusive growth and economic equity.
about.ourMissionDesc: Our mission is to empower women in business through comprehensive support systems including mentorship programs, networking opportunities, capacity building initiatives, and advocacy for gender equality in the workplace. We strive to create an inclusive ecosystem that enables women to overcome barriers, access funding opportunities, and build sustainable businesses that contribute to economic growth and social development.
